status_legend.asm_verified: Main behavior is backed by a concrete ASM branch/address and implemented to match it.
status_legend.asm_partial: Some behavior is backed by ASM, but important details are still unknown or approximated.
status_legend.data_verified: Asset/mapping details are confirmed from game data/Camoto, but runtime behavior may not be fully ASM-traced.
status_legend.heuristic: Implemented from visual testing or inferred behavior; needs ASM/data confirmation.
status_legend.known_wrong: Known to differ from the original game.
status_legend.unimplemented: Not implemented, placeholder, or prototype only.
